eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 12:00 AM on AUG 25, 2021 Effective until 10:00 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Goodyear police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Goodyear Police is looking for a white male, James Pestka. Hair, Gray, Eyes, Hazel, Height, 6 foot, weight, 260 pounds. : Last seen driving a Silver 2001 Chevrolet Tracker, AZ License Plate 9, 3, 3, T, K, J.....Faded paint and a black cover over a spare tire on the rear of the vehicle in the area of South 167th Drive, in Goodyear, en route to 158th Drive in Goodyear. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
